records.subject: You're in -- let's get Granite Studio set up
records.body:
Hi Mia,

Glad to have Granite Studio on Wrenfield. A good first step is setting up one real project with your actual tasks rather than a test one -- it makes the rest of the product click faster.

Let me know if you'd like a hand.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no first project, no invite, no milestone, zero tickets, and no reply to three outbound emails (email:ccdd1351, email:e9205dda, email:0e76e5b0). Total silence plus no self-serve progress suggests low unaided odds of activating in the remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: A hand with your first Granite Studio project
draft.body:
Hi Mia,

I know a new tool is easy to put off in a busy week, so I'll keep this short. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project — that's really all it takes to see what it's for.

If it's easier, I'm glad to set up a 15-minute call this week and walk through setting up one real project with you. Just reply with a day that suits and I'll work around your schedule.

Best,
Priya
